[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Subarray Product Less Than K** [LC 713 · Subarray Product Less Than K](https://leetcode.com/problems/subarray-product-less-than-k/){difficulty="Medium"}

Count, don't maximise. For a fixed right end `r`, all subarrays ending at `r` are `nums[i..r]` for $i = 0..r$; their products only *grow* as $i$ moves left (positivity). So the valid ones form a **suffix** of that list: from some `l` up to `r`. Maintain the window product and shrink `l` while the product reaches $k$; when it stops, every start in `l..r` is valid and there are exactly $r - l + 1$ of them. Add that count each step. This is the "count all subarrays ending at `r`" trick of @sec-sw-a4.

[Solved in full in @sec-sw-p4-a.]{.card-link}

:::
